questions.prompt: The Korean War ended in 1953 with what outcome?
questions.fact: No formal peace treaty has ever been signed, leaving the two states technically still at war.

questions.prompt: What force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun?
questions.fact: An orbiting body is continuously falling; it simply moves sideways fast enough to keep missing.

questions.prompt: The Stanley Cup is engraved with what?
questions.fact: Rings are removed and retired as the trophy fills, so older names move to the Hall of Fame.

questions.prompt: Which Coen brothers film centres on a bowling enthusiast called The Dude?
questions.fact: It underperformed at the box office and built its following almost entirely on home video.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.fact: Its name means eastern capital, adopted when the emperor moved there from Kyoto in 1868.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the Bennet sisters?
questions.fact: It was first drafted under a different title in the 1790s and heavily revised before publication some fifteen years later.

questions.prompt: Which number system uses only the digits 0 and 1?
questions.fact: Leibniz described it in 1703 and saw a theological elegance in representing everything with one and nothing.
